claim: In the matching retail DLL, the two Menu_SoundManager loop helpers called by FACT-0081 are exact method bodies. Play_CheerVoice_Loop (0x060052AD) is a static vid/volume method with exact signature blob 00020111aa000c and an exact 158-byte body. It returns unless Sound_ClipCheerVoice_List exists, raw vid is in 0..41, and clip[vid] is non-null. It computes local=Volume_Cheer*volume, replaces only ordered-negative values with 0.0f, replaces only ordered values above 1.0f with 1.0f, selects raw audioSrcInfo index 7 and its sRefAudio, and returns unless that AudioSource converts true. On success it calls set_volume(local), set_clip(clip), set_loop(true), Play(), then stores raw zero into fadeOutFrm and fadeOutCnt. SetVol_CheerVoice_Loop (0x060052B0) is a static Float32-volume method with exact signature blob 0001010c and an exact 76-byte body. It performs the same Volume_Cheer multiplication and ordered 0..1 clamps, selects the same raw audioSrcInfo index 7 / sRefAudio, tests the AudioSource conversion, and only when true calls set_volume(local). FACT-0081 pins the calls at IL+0x00FA and IL+0x010E.
